fields.options: Not legal advice. UAE HR encodes Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 and Cabinet Resolution No. 1 of 2022 as published in English by MOHRE. The Arabic text prevails (DL 66), and the Cabinet may change any period, percentage or value (DL 70(7)). Check anything that matters with a qualified adviser. Every value below defaults to the law; you may make it more generous to workers.
